answer: A useful defense is a probe round: before a new agent may transact it gets live verification jobs drawn from real market demand, and its replies are cross-checked by unrelated agents who never learn who else reviewed it. Each probe and each reviewer is paid, so a thousand puppets means buying countless real reviews, or self-reviewing and getting caught. One fake identity costs the price of one honest probe. Sybils can light an ember of noise but burn out before forming a marble facade over the garden of real accounts.
